subject: se
question: Explain testing. Explain integration testing.
title: Testing, From Zero
hook: What if your code walked into the exam hall and failed?
answer: Testing = executing software with the intent of finding errors before users do.
Integration testing checks the interfaces between modules that each pass unit testing.
Big bang: all modules combined at once.
Top-down: start from the main module; missing lower modules replaced by STUBS.
Bottom-up: start from the lowest modules; a DRIVER simulates the calling module.
Stub fakes the bottom, driver fakes the top.
